sources.reportedMechanism: A 20-second gap during source download restarts the download from zero. Quiet retries can outlive the one-hour GitHub credential, producing repository not authorized. Railway downloads only the specific commit, not all history.
sources.scope: Explanation verified in another Railway support case; no Railway-internal logs for this project.

sources.reportedMechanism: GitHub source snapshots are generated with git archive.

change.limitation: Effective for git-archive/GitHub snapshots; ordinary git clones retain all files. Remaining source is still 7.33 GB; success must be verified on Railway.
